text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The days of tackling challenges alongside 
Mejiro Bright, the easygoing, pace-setting 
lady of the Mejiro family, had begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is slow to start and slow to 
make her move. Yet, there is an 
unmistakable brilliance in her final 
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, though laid-back, she holds 
high aspirations. "Someday, I want to 
become a new light for the Mejiros." What 
kind of Umamusume will she become, as she 
says those words?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to watch over and support her 
throughout the Twinkle Series.
